activity_check.reason: Primary text supports E. coli >90% killing at 50 ug/mL by disulfide LEAP-2 and qualitative activity against S. aureus/L. monocytogenes, but APD6 compresses activity into one entry_text row and exact point values are not locally tabulated. S. aureus strain also differs between methods (ATCC 27664) and figure captions (ATCC 276674).

record_audits.conflict_context: APD6 row is traceable to this paper and broadly source-supported, but its structured activity fields are empty and its comments include compressed figure-derived claims; preserve as source_conflict rather than source_verified row-level assay data.
record_audits.review_notes: Do not promote APD6 entry_text to exact primary assay rows. Use worker-2 activity records for source-supported textual thresholds and keep exact plotted values unrecoverable.
